evidence.role: Escrows and verifies the exact configured NFT before creation completes.
Selects the NFT result when the reserve is met or exceeded.
Proves that the supplied ticket contains the selected winning entry.
Burns the winning ticket and delivers the configured NFT to its current owner with an ownership postcondition.
Excludes NftWon from the sponsor-return path.

searched.where: Five production files and all files in target/dependency-hashes.json
searched.result: All five production files and 31/31 pinned dependencies read in full; every dependency SHA-256 verified OK.
Result enforcement found at Raffle.sol:L521; configuration and ABI hits traced through RaffleFactory.sol, IRaffle.sol, and IRaffleFactory.sol; no dependency implements another result path.
15 relevant writes, all in Raffle.sol; reserveEntries is written only at L203, winningEntry/status at L519/L521, and winningTicketId at L552. totalEntries has exactly one assignment at L230.
Six implementation hits in Raffle.sol:L304-L305,L309,L315,L395,L533 and three interface declarations; no wrapper or second implementation path.
Exactly six first-party call sites: escrow at RaffleFactory.sol:L128-L129, winner delivery at Raffle.sol:L334-L335, and sponsor return at Raffle.sol:L404-L405.
Five comment-only escape-vocabulary hits; 0 prize approval hits; 0 first-party delegation or destruction hits.

reasoning: The exact configured NFT is escrowed and custody-checked at creation. An authenticated resolution writes NftWon for totalEntries >= reserveEntries. Both settlement orderings use the same winning-range proof, bind the winning ticket, require its current owner, burn the ticket, transfer the configured NFT, and verify post-transfer ownership. The sponsor-return branch rejects NftWon, and no alternate first-party escape path was found. This is implemented rather than partial because every reserve-met redemption path reaches the same enforcement.
